notes: All 7 records researched live. No calendar date was written for any record: no official source for this shard publishes a single unambiguous fixed calendar deadline for its record. Four records have an explicitly non-dated (rolling / no application) basis stated verbatim by the provider; three are UNKNOWN or have two cycle-specific official dates that cannot be reduced to one date.

Note the shard's cached application_period matches this live wording, but the conclusion here rests on the fetched page, not the cache.

records.title: UQ International Excellence Scholarship
records.deadline_display: You don't need to apply for this scholarship. When you apply to study a program at UQ, you're automatically assessed for this scholarship. ... We will let you know the deadline for accepting your scholarship offer.

source.as_of: Scholarship terms and conditions year 2027 (page links 'UQ International Excellence Scholarship TCs 2027.pdf'); eligibility stated for applicants commencing 2027
source.raw_extract: How to apply - You don't need to apply for this scholarship. When you apply to study a program at UQ, you're automatically assessed for this scholarship. What happens next - If you are eligible, we will notify you that you're offered this scholarship together with your unconditional letter of offer to study at UQ or once you have satisfied all the conditions of your conditional letter of offer. We will let you know the deadline for accepting your scholarship offer.
source.exact_deadline_wording: You don't need to apply for this scholarship. ... We will let you know the deadline for accepting your scholarship offer.
source.notes: The provider states there is no scholarship application and no published fixed date; the only deadline is communicated to the individual after an offer is issued. Classified ROLLING (no fixed deadline) rather than ANNUAL because UQ describes continuous automatic assessment rather than a recurring annual window. The live page does not use the word 'rolling' itself, hence the MEDIUM->HIGH confidence rests on the explicit 'You don't need to apply' wording; the accept-offer deadline is per-offer and cannot be published as a calendar value. Never dated, per brief section 6.
